records.description: QR Stickers is a website which simplifies the process of ordering QR Code stickers. If you've ever needed a QR Code sticker, you've probably gone through the tedious process of: 1. Generating a QR code on a random website and downloading an image file, 2. Uploading the image to a print shop's website and placing an order, 3. Waiting for a slow proof process involving back and forth emails. With QR Stickers you generate the QR code and place an order for stickers all under the same roof.

records.name: EchoLeads.ai
records.tagline: Autonomous AI Calling Automation
records.description: EchoLeads is an AI voice sales platform that deploys intelligent AI voice agents to automate outbound calling, lead qualification, and appointment scheduling. Built for modern revenue teams, the platform combines AI cold calling software, AI SDR automation, and real-time AI call automation to engage prospects at scale. From first contact to booked meetings, EchoLeads enables businesses to run fully automated voice AI for sales workflows that generate leads and nurture prospects.

records.name: StatusCraft – Beautiful Status Pages
records.tagline: Create a beautiful status page for your service in minutes
records.description: StatusCraft lets you build a professional status page — just like GitHub, Stripe, or Notion — without any setup hassle. ✅ Real-time uptime monitoring (every 5 minutes) ✅ Incident tracking & public announcements ✅ Clean, shareable status URL ✅ Free to start — no credit card needed Perfect for indie hackers, startups, and small teams who want to keep their users informed during outages.

records.name: Gratonite: Chat For Friends, By Friends
records.tagline: Custom Servers, video calls, E2EE DMs + custom cosmetics
records.description: Gratonite is a free, open-source alternative to Discord. Real-time chat, spatial voice, cosmetics, and an auction house, built by friends, for friends. Still in dev but fully functioning. Free forever Discord alternative by a first-time solo dev. Servers w/ moderation, E2EE DMs, spatial voice/video calls, custom cosmetics. Cross-platform (web, mobile, desktop). Just pure, cozy chat built by friends, for friends. Open-Source and self host-able. gratonite.chat

records.name: ProposalOS
records.tagline: Proposals, contracts and payments — all in one link
records.description: The simplest way for freelancers to send proposals, contracts and get paid — all in one link.

records.name: POS Prime
records.tagline: A modern, fast Point of Sale for ERPNext — open source
records.description: POS Prime is a modern Point of Sale app for ERPNext — the popular open source ERP. → Zero modifications to ERPNext — installs and uninstalls cleanly → Self-checkout kiosk mode & customer-facing displays → Barcode scanning, split payments, returns, batch/serial tracking → Works across ERPNext v14, v15, and v16 → Built with Vue 3 + Frappe UI + Tailwind CSS Free and open source (GPL v3).

records.name: Akela Bhai Web Design
records.tagline: Affordable websites for small businesses and creators
records.description: Akela Bhai is a web designer helping small businesses and creators build simple, fast and professional websites. The goal is to make it easy for anyone to launch their online presence without complicated tools or expensive agencies.

records.name: FeeDings! RSS, BenchCalc & Influence
records.tagline: UK-based software company building apps
records.description: UK software studio behind three apps: FeeDings RSS reader for news, podcasts & YouTube — BenchCalc, the lab calculator for scientists — and Influence, AI-powered choose-your-own-adventure stories.

records.name: JSON Formatter
records.tagline: Format, validate, and minify JSON instantly—no signup
records.description: JSON Formatter – Fast JSON formatting for developers Tired of slow, bloated JSON tools? JSON Formatter gives you instant validation, formatting, and minification without overhead. Features: Real-time formatting Validation Minification Copy & download No signup required Perfect for debugging APIs, testing configs, or formatting data on the fly.

records.name: Topvon Ai
records.tagline: Topvon AI AI Game Engineering Platform
records.description: Topvon AI is an advanced AI platform for game developers that generates complete game systems and architecture-level code. Users can choose different thinking modes (Fast, Deep, Deep Max) and architecture levels (Lite, Pro, Studio) to control the depth and complexity of the generated code. The platform supports 9 game engines and allows developers to generate, export, and explain code instantly, making game development faster, smarter, and more accessible.

records.name: Walletvy: AI Expense & Budget
records.tagline: On-device AI expense tracker with Tinder-like swipes.
records.description: Welletvy makes expense tracking fun and 100% private. Snap a receipt, and our On-Device AI processes it instantly without sending data to servers. Manage expenses with a gamified "Transaction Inbox"—just swipe to add or ignore! Track subscriptions effortlessly in a beautiful, offline-first app featuring aesthetic pastel tones and dark mode. Stop manual entry and start designing your financial life with a smart, stylish, and highly secure personal finance companion.

records.name: ℞ Print
records.tagline: A simple tool for printing digital prescriptions
records.description: RxPrint helps doctors and clinics print electronic prescriptions quickly and clearly. Many digital prescription systems produce layouts that are hard to print or read. RxPrint converts electronic prescription data into clean, printer-friendly formats in seconds. Designed specifically for healthcare workflows, it provides a simple interface, fast formatting, and reliable printing directly from the browser—helping medical professionals save time and avoid formatting issues.

records.name: Solangigs
records.tagline: Freelance marketplace connecting businesses with talent
records.description: Solangigs is a freelance marketplace designed to connect businesses with skilled professionals for remote work. From design and development to writing and marketing, Solangigs helps companies find trusted talent while empowering freelancers to earn from anywhere.

records.name: PlainTOS
records.tagline: AI that reads Terms of Service so you don't have to
records.description: Tired of clicking "I agree" without knowing what you're agreeing to? PlainTOS analyzes any Terms of Service instantly and shows you: 🚨 Red flags & hidden clauses 💰 Does it sell your data? ⚖️ Forced arbitration clause? 📝 Plain-English TL;DR Free to use, no account required. Pro plan for unlimited analyses at $9/month.

records.name: ideaforge AI
records.tagline: “Think It. Launch It.”
records.description: Describe your startup idea and AI generates a full working web app with UI, database schema, and exportable code.

records.name: MosHospital
records.tagline: instant medical care, anytime, anywhere
records.description: When it comes to your health, every second counts. MosHospital uses smart AI to help you find the right doctor and book appointments instantly no calls, no waiting. Our intelligent system connects patients with healthcare professionals in seconds, making access to care simple, fast, and secure. Our mission is simple: give you peace of mind with immediate access to care and an app that handles the details so you can focus on what matters most: your health.

records.name: AppReviewLens
records.tagline: Find startup ideas hidden in app reviews
records.description: Hi Product Hunt 👋 I’m Naj, a solo builder. I built AppReviewLens after noticing founders often build apps without knowing what users actually want. But the answers are already in App Store and Google Play reviews. Think of this as a central place for app reviews where you can quickly understand what users love, hate, and request. Before writing code, read the reviews. Would love feedback from the PH community.

records.name: CurrencyToUSD
records.tagline: Convert any foreign currency to US dollars instantly
records.description: Free currency converter to USD — convert yen, euro, yuan, baht, GBP, CAD & AUD to US dollars instantly with live exchange rates. Updated March 2026.

records.name: FinForecast Financial Forecasting App
records.tagline: Forecast cash flow, p&l and balance sheet in one model
records.description: Most forecasting tools start with a spreadsheet and layer charts on top. FinForecast does the opposite. It runs on a true three-statement forecasting engine where profit, cash and the balance sheet stay structurally linked. No manual clean-ups. No broken models. Built from years of CFO experience helping SMEs forecast cash runway, hiring and growth decisions

records.name: Nuvio
records.tagline: Comunícate sin limites
records.description: 🚀 Estoy lanzando una nueva app de chat llamada Nuvio. La idea es crear una comunidad para probar nuevas formas de comunicación. Si quieren probarla y dar feedback pueden descargarla aquí 👇 https://apk.e-droid.net/apk/app3947571-nx1hi2.apk?v=1

records.name: flux klein
records.tagline: Flux Klein – Flagship AI Photorealistic Generation Model
records.description: Flux Klein is the professional AI image generation model powered by Flux. It provides the best-in-class image generation experience with hyper-realistic textures.

records.name: Scribble Pass
records.tagline: Your new favorite party game!
records.description: Scribble Pass is a hilarious pass-the-phone party game: draw a prompt, pass to the next player to guess (or draw worse), and watch chaos unfold with terrible scribbles and wild guesses. Digital Pictionary + telephone—no accounts needed. Perfect for game nights, parties, road trips. Core free; premium unlock for extra features. Just launched on iOS—download free & try it! https://apps.apple.com/us/app/scribble-pass/id6759349730 Feedback welcome: Share your worst drawing fail 👇 Solo indie dev.

records.name: The Oracle's Lot
records.tagline: The Otcale's Lot a  new Rune style game from 3000 BC
records.description: Explore the mysteries of The Oracle's Lot. Discover deep insights, spiritual guidance, and the path to understanding your destiny.

records.name: MySoloFounder
records.tagline: An AI Team That Helps You Build Your Startup
records.description: This a ai startup team web app help for those people who want to start there own startup but don't have proper guide

records.name: DXB Dips
records.tagline: Track luxury property price drops in Dubai, in real time.
records.description: Dubai's luxury property market is shifting. Prices are softening after years of growth, but buyers have no way to see which specific listings have quietly dropped. DXB Dips fixes that. It tracks real-time price drops on 19,000+ luxury listings (4M+ AED sales, 250K+ AED/yr rentals) pulled directly from Property Finder. Full price history per listing, filterable by area, property type, and time window. Free. No sign-up.

records.name: Scriptly
records.tagline: Build AI Support Chatbots Trained on Your Website & Docs
records.description: Scriptly lets you build AI-powered support chatbots trained on your website, documents, and FAQs in minutes. Automatically answer customer questions, reduce support workload, and provide instant 24/7 responses. Simply add your content, train the AI, and embed the chatbot on your website with a single script.
